UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated MOTORA owner profile storing preferences and primary vehicle pointer.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vehicle owner.

primaryVehicleId.description: Document ID of the user's currently selected primary vehicle.

Vehicle.title: Vehicle
Vehicle.description: Registered vehicle owned by an authenticated MOTORA user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vehicle owner.

bodyStyle.description: Body silhouette category for studio presentation.

engineDisplacement.description: Optional engine displacement (e.g., 1998 cc) or N/A / Unknown.

fuelType.description: Fuel or energy type or Unknown / Unavailable.

photoUri.description: Optional primary vehicle photo URI path.

anglePhotos.description: Optional multi-angle studio photos keyed by FRONT, SIDE_LEFT, REAR, SIDE_RIGHT.

aiInspectionSummary.description: Optional Gemini Vision multi-angle exterior summary clearly labeled as AI-assisted.

primary.description: Whether this vehicle is currently selected as the primary garage vehicle.

verificationStatus.description: Verification status; demonstration, AI-extracted, and user data are never marked OEM-verified.

unknownFields.description: List of specification field keys explicitly marked unknown or unavailable.

VehicleDiagnosisLog.title: VehicleDiagnosisLog
VehicleDiagnosisLog.description: Persisted car problem consultation log created from AI mechanic chat for a specific registered vehicle.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vehicle owner.

userPrompt.description: Plain-language symptom or question entered by the owner.

aiSummary.description: Kid-simple AI explanation summary of the car problem.

attachmentType.description: Type of media attached during the AI consultation.

attachmentLabel.description: Optional filename or short label describing attached photo, file, or audio duration.

modelCommonality.description: How common this symptom is on the owner's car model.

followUpQuestion.description: Clarifying follow-up question asked by AI (such as sound location).

resolved.description: Whether the owner marked this car issue as resolved.

SavedObdSessionRecord.title: SavedObdSessionRecord
SavedObdSessionRecord.description: Persisted read-only OBD-II diagnostic session summary, findings, and technician report for a registered vehicle.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vehicle owner.

vehicleTitle.description: Display title of the vehicle at scan time.

adapterOrFileLabel.description: Adapter name, imported filename, or manual entry label.

reliabilityLevel.description: Reliability rating of the captured diagnostic evidence.

ownerSymptoms.description: Optional symptoms recorded by the vehicle owner.

headlineSummary.description: Everyday language summary of the diagnostic findings.

dtcCodes.description: List of normalized OBD-II trouble codes associated with the session.

findingTitles.description: Titles of diagnostic findings generated by the engine.

telemetrySummary.description: Formatted PID sensor readings (with unavailable values marked Unavailable).

missingInformation.description: Explicitly listed missing sensors or vehicle context.

mechanicChecklist.description: Actionable handoff verification points for a qualified technician.

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner profile document isolated per authenticated Firebase user.

/users/{userId}/vehicles/{vehicleId}.description: Owner-isolated subcollection of registered vehicles belonging to {userId}.

/users/{userId}/vehicles/{vehicleId}/dia.description: Owner-isolated history log of AI car problem Q&As and audio/photo/file checks per vehicle.

/users/{userId}/vehicles/{vehicleId}/obd.description: Owner-isolated history of read-only OBD-II scans, manual DTC checks, imported logs, and mechanic reports per vehicle.
